title: Image Downloader, Image Search
summary: Search & download HD images, wallpapers and GIFs. Fast, simple & free.
description:
Image Downloader – Image Search – Pic Finder is a small but powerful image search app for Android. Quickly search, find and download any kind of image: HD wallpapers, memes, quotes, jokes, status images, presentation material, GIFs and more. Use smart filters to refine your results and save only what you need.

Key Features:
• High quality image search for Android
• Lightweight image downloader with small installation size
• Powerful search filters to narrow down results (size, type, etc.)
• Fast and free image searching and photo downloading
• Search history so you can easily repeat previous image searches
• Built-in downloads gallery to manage your saved photos and pictures
• Built-in image viewer with zoom in / zoom out
• Download multiple images at the same time
• High speed image and photo downloader
• Smart search suggestions while you type your query
• Set any image as wallpaper directly from the app
• Share images and animated GIFs with other apps and social networks
• Download HD images, backgrounds and wallpapers
• Easy to use image search app for Android
• Supports multiple languages

Set images as wallpaper
Find HD images and wallpapers and set them as your home screen or lock screen background directly from the Image Downloader app.

Share images and GIFs
Share high quality photos, pictures and animated GIFs with friends, family or on social media in just a few taps.

Search history
Your search history is saved in the app so you can quickly open previous queries or search again by tapping a history item. You can disable search history at any time in the app settings.

Downloads gallery
All downloaded HD images are stored inside the app in a simple gallery. View your images with the built-in image viewer and use zoom in / zoom out as needed.

Disclaimer:
• Image Downloader is an easy to use image search tool that helps you find images available on the internet.
• Any unauthorized actions (such as downloading or using photos without permission) and any violations of intellectual property rights are the sole responsibility of the user.
